entries.reasoning: TravelHub qualifies as a Hospitality Business because it provides distribution services to hotel partners. AtliQ Inc is an Affiliate of the entity bound by the Al Noor non-compete. The proposed services (AI-driven ranking and performance analytics) for properties in the UAE and KSA constitute providing artificial intelligence and data analytics services to a Hospitality Business in the GCC.

incomingClauses.quote: Partner Hotel Ranking Module — a ranking and recommendation service that scores, ranks and surfaces Partner Hotels in the United Arab Emirates and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia to TravelHub users at the point of search and itinerary building, taking into account user fit, price competitiveness, partner commission tier, availability and conversion likelihood, and that drives the sort order of hotel results and "recommended stay" placements for booking through the TravelHub App;
Partner Performance Dashboard — a dashboard for TravelHub's partnerships team showing impressions, click-through, bookings and commission by Partner Hotel, city and ranking position;
Invoices under this Agreement shall be raised by AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd, GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3, on or after Acceptance of each milestone as set out in Schedule B.
Partner Hotel Ranking Module v1 — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Riyadh, Jeddah

entries.suggestedChange: Seek an express written waiver from Al Noor Hospitality Group LLC or remove all hotel-related ranking, distribution, and analytics features for GCC properties from the scope of work.
entries.waiverWhy: The Seaside waiver is strictly limited to demand-forecasting services for a specific hotel in Oman and explicitly excludes other Hospitality Businesses in the GCC or other services.
entries.impact: Collides with the Al Noor promise, live until Sep 2029.

covenants.quote: During the term and for twelve (12) months thereafter, neither Party shall solicit for employment any employee of the other Party directly involved in the Services.
covenants.impact: This non-solicitation provision does not restrict AtliQ from serving existing clients.
